title: Steel Axe
body:
"Forged with 100% pure steel, this will do some serious damage (but faster)"

Description

Steel Axe is an axe sold at The Oak Depot for $5,000. It's a bigger and faster version of a now removed Old Steel Axe.

A nice and affordable choice for intermediate players.

Appearance

Steel Axe is a tall hatchet made out of wood and steel. It's headpiece is dark gray in color and uses the default legacy metal texture. Handle, like any other axe, is made out of dark brown wood with default legacy wood material applied to it. At the bottom of it there is a small hole.

Trivia

  • Before v1.52.0 it was named Tall Steel Axe
  • In the past, there existed a smaller and weaker version of this axe - Old Steel Axe.
